//! Writes a small KZero chess data file from fixed games, for TrueZero interop tests.
use std::borrow::Cow;

use board_game::board::{Board, BoardMoves};
use board_game::games::chess::{ChessBoard, Rules};
use board_game::pov::ScalarPov;
use board_game::wdl::WDL;
use internal_iterator::InternalIterator;
use kz_core::mapping::chess::ChessStdMapper;
use kz_core::network::ZeroEvaluation;
use kz_core::zero::values::ZeroValuesPov;
use kz_selfplay::binary_output::BinaryOutput;
use kz_selfplay::simulation::{Position, Simulation};

fn main() {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    let out = &args[1];
    let games_file = std::fs::read_to_string(&args[2]).unwrap();
    let rules = Rules::default();
    let mapper = ChessStdMapper;
    let mut output = BinaryOutput::new(out, "chess", mapper).unwrap();

    for line in games_file.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()) {
        let (fen, moves) = line.split_once('|').unwrap();
        let mut board = if fen.trim() == "startpos" {
            ChessBoard::default_with_rules(rules)
        } else {
            ChessBoard::new_without_history_fen(fen.trim(), rules)
        };
        let mut positions = vec![];
        for (i, mv_str) in moves.split_whitespace().enumerate() {
            let mv = board.parse_move(mv_str).unwrap();
            let mut weights = vec![];
            board.available_moves().unwrap().for_each(|m| {
                // depends only on the (absolute) from-square, so it is independent of how
                // either implementation encodes castling
                weights.push(1.0 + (m.get_source().to_index() % 7) as f32);
            });
            let total: f32 = weights.iter().sum();
            let zero_policy: Vec<f32> = weights.iter().map(|w| w / total).collect();
            let n = zero_policy.len();
            let net_policy = vec![1.0 / n as f32; n];
            positions.push(Position {
                board: board.clone(),
                is_full_search: i % 2 == 0,
                played_mv: mv,
                zero_visits: 100 + i as u64,
                zero_evaluation: ZeroEvaluation {
                    values: ZeroValuesPov { value: ScalarPov::new(0.25), wdl: WDL::new(0.5, 0.25, 0.25), moves_left: i as f32 },
                    policy: Cow::Owned(zero_policy),
                },
                net_evaluation: ZeroEvaluation {
                    values: ZeroValuesPov { value: ScalarPov::new(-0.1), wdl: WDL::new(0.2, 0.3, 0.5), moves_left: 7.0 },
                    policy: Cow::Owned(net_policy),
                },
            });
            board.play(mv).unwrap();
        }
        output.append(&Simulation { positions, final_board: board }).unwrap();
    }
    output.finish().unwrap();
}
